description: One ReliefWeb report in full — the complete body text, every attached file, the publishing organisations, the countries and disasters it covers, its theme and format, and its publication and revision dates. Use it after reliefweb_reports to read a situation report rather than only its title. Pass the numeric report id from a reliefweb_reports result. Requires a caller-supplied ReliefWeb appname in _apiKey.

max_body_chars.description: Truncate the body to this many characters (default 8000, max 40000).

report_id.description: Numeric ReliefWeb report id, as returned by reliefweb_reports, e.g. "4142589".

name: reliefweb_report
title: Reliefweb Report
